sql_model.form_descr: Tenant business occupying a rented unit. One profile per unit; a new tenant after a removal is entered by editing the Removed record and pressing Re-activate (previous details are overwritten).

column.name: unit_no
column.heading: Unit No
column.descr: Rented unit (must have a Member Profile with occupancy Given on Rent)

validations.name: Unit is given on rent
validations.message: A tenant can be added only for a unit whose Member Profile is Given on Rent.

validations.name: One tenant per unit
validations.message: Unit {form.unit_no} already has a Tenant Profile. Edit it and use Re-activate.

column.name: tenant_status
column.heading: Tenant Status
column.descr: Active or Removed; changed only by the Remove Tenant / Re-activate buttons

column.name: can_update_profile
column.heading: Can Update Profile
column.descr: Whether the owner lets the tenant maintain this profile (from Member Profile)

column.name: owner_occupancy_type
column.heading: Owner Occupancy Type
column.descr: Occupancy type of the unit (from Member Profile)

validations.name: Category exists
validations.message: Business category {form.business_category} not found.

validations.name: Valid phone 2
validations.message: Contact No 2 must be a valid phone number.

validations.name: Contacts differ

validations.name: Valid tenant email

validations.name: Email not an owner email

validations.name: Email not an owner primary email

column.name: show_in_directory
column.heading: Show in Directory

builtin.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN {form.show_in_directory} = 'N' OR SHOW_TENANT_IN_DIRECTORY = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM CCW_MEMBER_PROFILE WHERE UNIT_NO = {form.unit_no}

validations.name: Show in Directory is a listed value
validations.message: Show in Directory must be one of: Y, N

builtin.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN {form.login_enabled} = 'N' OR TENANT_LOGIN_ALLOWED = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM CCW_MEMBER_PROFILE WHERE UNIT_NO = {form.unit_no}

validations.name: Login Enabled is a listed value
validations.message: Login Enabled must be one of: Y, N

confirmation.message: Remove tenant {form.tenant_company_name} from unit {form.unit_no}? Their login and directory entry will be switched off.

validations.name: Tenant must be Active
validations.message: Only an Active tenant can be removed.

business_logic.description: Remove the tenant from the unit
business_logic.spec: Payload: the row (UNIT_NO ...) plus REMOVAL_REASON captured from the user. If REMOVAL_REASON is blank (after trimming) return {"error": "A removal reason is required."}. If the stored TENANT_STATUS is not 'A' return {"error": "Only an Active tenant can be removed."}. UPDATE CCW_TENANT_PROFILE SET TENANT_STATUS = 'R', LOGIN_ENABLED = 'N', SHOW_IN_DIRECTORY = 'N', REMOVED_ON = current timestamp, REMOVAL_REASON = the reason, CHG_DATE = current timestamp WHERE UNIT_NO = the unit. Do not touch CCW_UNIT_MASTER (occupancy stays Given on Rent) or any guest entries / facility requests. Return {"message": "Tenant removed from unit <UNIT_NO>."}. Access: the button is granted only to the unit's owners and management (never to tenants).

confirmation.message: Re-activate the tenant profile of unit {form.unit_no} with the details currently saved? A welcome email will be sent to {form.tenant_email}.

validations.name: Tenant must be Removed
validations.message: Only a Removed tenant profile can be re-activated.

validations.name: Unit still on rent
validations.message: The unit's Member Profile is no longer Given on Rent.

business_logic.spec: Payload: the row (UNIT_NO). Require the stored TENANT_STATUS = 'R' and that TENANT_COMPANY_NAME, CONTACT_PERSON, CONTACT_NO_1 and TENANT_EMAIL are non-blank (the new tenant's details must have been entered by editing the Removed record first); otherwise return {"error": ...} naming the missing field. Also require the unit's CCW_MEMBER_PROFILE.OCCUPANCY_TYPE = 'R'. UPDATE CCW_TENANT_PROFILE SET TENANT_STATUS = 'A', REMOVED_ON = NULL, REMOVAL_REASON = NULL, LOGIN_ENABLED = 'N' unless the owner's TENANT_LOGIN_ALLOWED = 'Y' and the stored LOGIN_ENABLED = 'Y', SHOW_IN_DIRECTORY = 'N' unless the owner's SHOW_TENANT_IN_DIRECTORY = 'Y' and the stored value = 'Y', CHG_DATE = current timestamp WHERE UNIT_NO = the unit. Return {"message": "Tenant profile re-activated."}.

business_logic.description: No repeated additional business category in the grid
business_logic.spec: Receives {action, txn_id, header, details}. Take the Other Categories lines (form 2) from details (ignore lines marked deleted). If the same CATEGORY_CODE (trimmed, case-insensitive) appears on two or more lines return {"error": "Business category <code> is listed more than once under Additional Business Categories."}. If any line's CATEGORY_CODE equals header BUSINESS_CATEGORY (case-insensitive) return {"error": "Business category <code> is already the primary Business Category."}. Otherwise return nothing. This covers duplicates inside one save, which the per-row must-be-unique check cannot see.
